notes.title: Patch Notes - Release 1.0.5
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JzqYehE.png[/img]
[h1]Release Notes 1.0.5 (Website/Discord)[/h1][h2]Active Events Update[/h2]
We’ve heard your feedback that more of you would love to just play Punch Royale, so we’ve shifted the Game Modes to the following:
[list][*]FEATURED: Punch Royale, FFA. Eligible for Crowns[/*][*]FEATURED: Points Modes, FFA. Includes Sugar Rush, Crab Crush, King of the Hill, and Deathmatch. Eligible for Crowns.[/*][*]EVENT: Goop Cube Teams Rotation. Rotates between Duos, Trios, and Squads[/*][*]EVENT: Teams Modes Rotation. Rotates between Duos, Trios, and Squads of Point Scoring modes, including 2v2, 10v10, and 4v4.[/*][*]WEEKENDS: 1v1 Me, Bro[/*][/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oOwaVAo.png[/img]

Our goal is to allow people to play lots of different types of game modes while maintaining high-quality matches and short matchmaking times. We’re open to continuing to change this format, so please leave feedback in Discord on what you’d like to see!

[h2]Stream Queue fixes[/h2][list][*]If you receive a Stream Queue invite while on the Match Complete screen, it gives you the chance to join[/*][*]When a Stream Queue Party fills up, the dialog auto-closes.[/*][*]If your Party gets more than 20 players in it, we ask if you want to create a Stream Queue instead[/*][*]Stream Queues can be opened directly from the “Party” button if Streamer Mode is enabled.[/*][/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GtEHGzK.png[/img]

[h2]New Stuff[/h2][list][*]NEW SHOP SECTION: Outfit Shop! There’s specific cosmetics available to purchase directly for Gems, updated daily.[/*][list][*]Random Cosmetic Boxes: Buy x5 to get a guaranteed Epic. Buy x10 to get a guaranteed legendary[/*][*]Added Punching Ring to the 1v1 and 2v2 Private Match pool for private matches.[/*][*]Added the Creator Code entry into the Shop[/*][*]Mobile players can be Founders too! Founder’s Packs are available in the in-game Shop[/*][list][*]If you already have the Super or Super+ Rumble Pass and you purchase a Founder’s Pack you’ll receive the following Gems instead:[/*][list][*]Super: 180 Gems[/*][*]Super+: 300 Gems[/*][/list][/list][/list][*]To reduce confusion, Punchies previewed in Bundles will just be Blue Punchies wearing whatever cosmetics are sold in the Bundle. They won’t preview your cosmetics anymore.[/*][/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2][list][*]Deathmatch timeout duration increased by 60 seconds.[/*][*]Deathmatch Duos score to win changed from 30->25.[/*][*]Deathmatch Trios score to win changed from 45->35.[/*][*]Deathmatch Squads score to win changed from 60->45.[/*][*]Added 10 additional dropping tiles to Beach Ballin’ Deathmatch.[/*][*]Added 9 additional dropping tiles to Under Construction Deathmatch.[/*][/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*]Fixed an exploit where players could defy gravity forever on Spaced Out.[/*][*]Fixed the controller scroll speed on Crown Road.[/*][*]Fixed the Team numbers to be consistent between the Lobby and in-match in Private Matches.[/*][*]Fixed a bug in Crab Crush where the timer didn’t reset when everyone fell below the points threshold[/*][*]Fixed a bug in Crab Crush where the timer didn’t reset when someone else takes the lead[/*][*]Fixed a bug with tile droppers on Under Construction (Crab Crush).[/*][*]Fixed a bug with a floating item spawner on Wrekt 2v2.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where cosmetics unlocked through the Rumble Pass erroneously said they were duplicates[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Spectate UI could persist if you watched a Replay and then played a match[/*][*]Fixed an issue where extra players would sometimes spawn in a Trios match[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Mode Picker didn’t close when the match is starting[/*][*]Fixed a bug where players would spawn under the boat in 2v2 Boxing Ring.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where players would sometimes show as “invisible”, when they were actually rendering under the ground.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where sometimes the wrong Map or Game Mode would display when playing a Public match in a Party.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where dropped gadgets could sometimes land above the ground[/*][*]Fixed a bug where sometimes ads would break in-game music and sound effects.[/*][*]Fixed a bug where the Anvil quest doesn’t progress[/*][*]Fixed a bug where “We Gamin’” was marked as a Twitch Drop, not an Epic exclusive.[/*][*]Temporarily disabled the in-game News button while we sort out some performance issues that it was causing[/*][/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eoqbCVe.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OVgL6tN.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nzUwm2K.png[/img]

If you have any additional feedback, we'd love to hear it! [url=discord.gg/rumbleclub]Join our Discord and come hang out[/url]!
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ghaZ6wZ.png[/img]

- Lightfox Games

notes.title: Patch notes: Rumble Club 1.0
notes.notes:
We’re just a few days away from the worldwide launch of Rumble Club!  Since our playtest last month, we’ve made a few changes. 

From some highly requested new game modes to a range of fixes and balance tweaks, read on for all the details.  

And don’t forget to hop into our [url=www.discord.gg/rumbleclub]Discord[/url] for more updates on Rumble Club. 

[h1][b][u]Patch Notes: [/u][/b][/h1]
[b]Trophy Road and Crown Road[/b]
Get rewards for earning Trophies and Crowns, including exclusive Accessories!

[b]Event Rotation[/b]
We’ve added a permanent Goop Cube Event to the Game Mode Selector! Rotating between Duos, Trios, and Squads, you’ll always be able to play Goop Cube with a friend.

[b]New Game Modes[/b]
We’ve added new game modes to Rumble Club that are found in Events, Private Matches, and even the Random - Free For All bucket. Check out what’s new below!

[u]Crab Crush[/u]
[list]
[*] Eliminate Punchies to spawn crabs. Punch Crabs to collect them. Hold 15 crabs to win!
[*] Crab Crush comes in Solo, Duos, Trios, and Squads variants
[*] Crab Crush will appear in the Random - Free for All Playlist and in Private Matches
[/list]
[u]Deathmatch[/u]
[list]
[*] Deathmatch has been promoted from an Event mode to a Core mode!
[*] Eliminate Punchies to increase your score, first to 15 wins!
[*] Deathmatch comes in Solo, Duos, Trios, and Squads variants
[*] Crab Crush will appear in the Random - Free for All Playlist, in Event Modes, and in Private Matches
[/list]
[u]Goop Cube - Teams[/u]
[list]
[*] Take on another Team, last team standing wins!
[*] 2v2 and 10v10 variants are available
[*] 2v2 and 10v10 Goop Cube will appear in Event Modes and Private Matches[/list]
[u]3v3 Sugar Rush[/u]
[list]
[*] Take on a more competitive version of Sugar Rush! The only sources of Cupcakes are a single tray or eliminating enemies, so get punching.
[*] 3v3 Sugar Rush will appear in Event Modes and Private Matches
[/list]
[u]5 Player Sugar Rush[/u]
[list]
[*] Take on a more competitive version of Sugar Rush! The only sources of Cupcakes are a single tray or eliminating enemies, so get punching.
[*] 5 Player Sugar Rush will appear in Event Modes
[/list]
[b]Map Picker Update[/b]
The Private Match map picker has been updated to be a lot easier to navigate. You can now select party size, then game mode and then map. 2v2, 10v10, 4v4, Deathmatch, and Crab Crush are now available in Private Matches

[b]Twitch Drops and Integration[/b]
[list]
[*] Watch your favorite Rumble Club streams and earn rewards, including an exclusive 3D Glasses cosmetic
[*] Connect with Twitch to show your Twitch Name in Private Lobbies
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937603/4a6872c5ce177429560eb3b09e59a920fcfcef89.png[/img]
[b]Balance[/b]
[u]Goop Cube[/u]
[list]
[*] The goal is to make Goop Cube matches be a bit less chaotic at the end. Matches frequently ended with 10+ players all alive on a single tile, which was a little too much chaos.
[*] Increased Goop Cube duration from 14s->20s
[*] Increased Goop Cube Throw distance by 30%
[*] Increased the time it takes for Goop Cube maps to get down to a single tile.
[/list]
[u]Sugar Rush [/u]
[list]
[*] Decreased single cupcake pickup time from 0.75s to 0.4s
[*] Decreased the number of cupcakes that randomly spawn from 18->14.
[*] Increased the number of cupcakes that spawn from an elimination from 1 to 2
[/list]
[u]Combat[/u]
[list]
[*] Increased the knockout time after being thrown from 0.7 to 0.8 seconds.
[/list]
[u]Gadgets[/u]
[list]
[*] Mailbox knockback distance increased by 20%.
[*] Mailbox knockback height decreased by 50%.
[*] Balloon Launcher now applies one strike on indirect hits and 2 strikes on direct hits.
[*] Umbrella knockback distance increased by 30%.
[*] Umbrella block reliability increased by making the block area a bit thicker.
[*] Drone now applies a strike on indirect hits.
[*] Hamster Ball now applies a strike when it lands.
[*] Magic Donut knockback distance increased by 20%.
[*] Magic Donut knockback height decreased by 20%.
[*] Magic Donut can no longer turn to aim while slamming.
[*] Punch Tank charge levels now apply 0/1/2 strikes.
[*] Anti-Grav Tool knockback distance increased by 50%.
[*] Anti-Grav Tool knockback height decreased by 60%.
[*] Anti-Grav Tool float power decreased to help prevent flying on low gravity maps.
[*] UFO pull power increased by 30%.
[*] Ice Machine projectile knockback reduced from 40/80/100 to 25/50/65.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a floating spawner in SE corner of Wreckt 1v1
[*] Fixed a bug where the smallest asteroids would explode if you touched them even if they weren’t moving after someone else had thrown them.
[*] Fixed a bug where the lava rocks would explode if you touched them even if they weren’t moving after someone else had thrown them.
[*] Fixed “New Zones Available!” bug on Factory and Jewel of Denial in Sugar Rush
[*] Fixed two trees in Jewel of Denial that get cupcakes stuck on top of them when you punch them.
[*] Fixed a bug where Lava Rocks in eruption and Crazy Caldera were not applying strikes.
[/list]
[b]Controller Support in menus[/b]
You can now use your controller to navigate throughout all menus in the game. Lean back!
